title: cache

```{r}
#| include: false
source("clag.R")
threshold <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("THRESH", "0"))
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
cat("COMPUTED\n", file = "computed.log", append = TRUE)
x <- 3
warning("cached-warning")
```

Prose: `r x`{.num claim=". > threshold"} [rose | fell]{if="x > threshold"}.
